_includeNote: `purger/**/*.js` and `workers/**/*.js` are here on purpose. Those files are
CommonJS because the purger runs as `node purger/index.js` with no build
step and no loader hook — the process that erases a tenant should have as
little between the source and the running code as possible. That is a
reason to be CommonJS; it was never a reason to be UNCHECKED. They carry
`// @ts-check` and JSDoc, and listing them here is what points tsc at them.
Nothing about the runtime changes: no rename, no emit, no flag.
